schemaNote: Phase 0B.4 recipe-row evidence ledger (Issue #182 / PR #183 comment #5775202410). Tracks every individually-evidenced PIZZA DB ja-172 population row (both the 25 comparison-table samples from Phase 0B and any individual-profile-page rows added since), deduplicated by nameJa/id, so 'unique recipe rows evidenced' is always a real, non-inflated count. Read/appended by tools/progression2_recipe_row_ingest.py. No PIZZA DB descriptive prose is copied -- only factual row fields (name, origin, dough style, sauce family, ingredient list) and this session's own evidence-gap/mechanic-identity notes.

existingRowsFromComparisonTableSamples.note: Full per-row detail lives in the Phase 0B samples file; this ledger references them by count/origin rather than duplicating their content.

counters.uniqueRecipeRowsEvidencedFormula: 25 (Phase 0B original comparison_table_sample) + 9 (later comparison_table_sample batches) + 7 (individual_profile_page) = 41, all deduplicated against each other
counters.independentlyFreshVerifiedNote: Rows evidenced via a dedicated individual PIZZA DB profile-page fetch (deeper single-dish evidence: origin/dough/sauce-family/ingredients), as distinct from a row's appearance in the aggregate comparison-table scrape.
counters.relayedOnlyNote: Rows evidenced only via the aggregate comparison-table sample (Phase 0B), not (yet) confirmed by a dedicated individual profile-page fetch.
counters.duplicateCorroborationsNote: Each entry in the top-level 'corroborations' list is a re-confirmation of an already-evidenced row (new source URL/date), found either by exact id/nameJa match (matchType=automatic_exact_match) or by human ingredient-set review (matchType=manual_review) -- never counted toward uniqueRecipeRowsEvidencedTotal.
counters.rowsCorrespondingToExistingCatalogEntryN: correspondsToExistingCatalogId is set whether that catalog entry is already SHIPPED (e.g. margherita) or still an unshipped candidate (e.g. hawaiian) -- check each row's own correspondenceNote for which.

independentSessionFetchStatus.note: This Claude Code session still cannot independently fetch any PIZZA DB page, individual-profile or otherwise. 'individual_profile_page' evidenceOrigin above describes the RELAYING agent's fetch method, not this session's own verification depth -- every row in this ledger remains owner-relayed and unverified by this session, regardless of evidenceOrigin.
